outcome: Reference ranges for cerebral tissue oxygen saturation (crSO2) and regional cerebral fractional tissue oxygen extraction (cFTOE) measured by Masimo O3 oximeter during the first 15 minutes after birth
cohort: 44 healthy term newborns delivered by primary cesarean section
finding: This study established reference ranges for crSO2 and cFTOE measured with the Masimo O3 oximeter during the immediate neonatal transition and found that values were higher than those obtained with other oximeters.
mod_finding: This study investigated cerebral oxygenation in newborns delivered by primary cesarean section.
